verdict.rationale: The smolagents README states directly that agents can use tools from any MCP server, which is the core of this MCP-client story, offered as a first-party capability of the library. The evidence is a single README line with no setup detail. Missing for 10: documented API or how-to for connecting MCP servers (transports such as stdio/SSE, configuration), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: You can use tools from any MCP server
